evidence.detail: R110 EditorKitUtilityCommandHandler handles texture/textures by enabling the live rs/l/e/a/u singleton, resetting its start texture ID to 0 and emitting the exact message 'Textures opened'.
The HIGH-layer renderer iterates the global rs/l/E.y texture array from the current start ID, draws each texture in a grid and labels every cell with the exact text '@gre@ID <id>'.
The default grid is exactly 8 columns by 5 rows; Editor Kit/resizable mode recalculates the column/row counts from the live client window dimensions.
For texture IDs >= 40 the renderer attempts Client.a(id, 50L) before drawing, then renders the corresponding texture sprite when present.
While active, the keyboard handler pages the start ID left/right by one complete grid page, clamps it to zero and below the texture-array length, and closes the browser on ESC (key code 27).
The class extends R112 InteractiveClientOverlay, is visible exactly while its active flag is true, and its interaction hook claims input codes 1 and 2.

proposals.note: TextureBrowserOverlay is descriptive exact-behavior recovery for the live texture ID grid/browser opened by the exact texture/textures commands. No surviving original source noun is asserted; confidence is 0.999.
